subject: ICETEA status: estimators reproduced, UKB preprocessing is the long pole
body:
Dmitri, Alina,

Status. The estimator suite reproduces on IHDP and ACIC - all estimators in estimators.py land within published tolerances, and Nikhil's experiment configs (via config.py) sweep cleanly.

Image side: Linnea's de-duplication pipeline is working end-to-end on a 10% sample - it's flagging about 7% of images as near-duplicates, which confirms the split-leakage worry was justified. The long pole is the UK Biobank-style preprocessing in ukb.py: the beam pipeline hits throughput limits on the resize/quality-filter stage, currently ~14 hours per full pass where we budgeted 6. Tereza has a fix (fusing the filter stages) in review.

Risk to the May 11 date: if the fused pipeline doesn't hold, benchmark v1 ships with the 60% subset that's already clean rather than the full corpus. Statistically fine for v1 - the semi-synthetic treatment assignment is ours anyway - but we should agree on that fallback now rather than at the deadline.

Halima
